name: Abnormal telemetry: CFE_ES es resets
description: cFE processor-reset count climbing — repeated exploitation or instability.
author: Elastic
false_positives: Authorized high-activity operations (a planned payload burst, a maintenance window, an orbital eclipse for power) can move this metric. Tune per mission via detection exceptions at deployment.
note:
## SPARTA Investigation Guide

### Detection logic
A machine-learning anomaly job (`high_mean` on `parameters.PROCESSORRESETS`) over the `CFE_ES_HKPACKET` telemetry in `logs-pisat-telemetry`. It learns the packet's normal range and flags a deviation, attributed to the packet/subsystem via influencers. cFE processor-reset count climbing — repeated exploitation or instability.

### Framework reference
- **Tactic:** Impact
- **Technique IMP-0003:** [Denial](https://sparta.aerospace.org/technique/IMP-0003/)

### How to validate this alert
Confirm the metric's deviation against the recent baseline, correlate its timing with the command feed (hazardous / flooding rules) and the SPACECOP IDS alert, and ask the AI agent to attribute any correlated command to a registered operator. See spartastixkb for countermeasures.
